```yaml
name: CI/CD and Release Infrastructure

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Check for broken dependencies
        run: cargo check --all

      - name: Format code
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

      - name: Run Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all -- -D warnings

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --all

      - name: Build for multiple platforms
        run: |
          mkdir -p target/release
          cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu -j $(nproc)
          cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc -j $(nproc)
          cargo build --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin -j $(sysctl -n hw.ncpu)

  release:
    needs: ci
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Create release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: v0.0.7
          release_name: Release v0.0.7
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Upload binaries
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: target/release/azul-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          asset_name: azul-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          asset_content_type: application/octet-stream

      - name: Upload Windows binary
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: target/release/azul-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe
          asset_name: azul-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe
          asset_content_type: application/octet-stream

      - name: Upload macOS binary
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: target/release/azul-x86_64-apple-darwin
          asset_name: azul-x86_64-apple-darwin
          asset_content_type: application/octet-stream

# .github/workflows/release.yml ends here

# CHANGELOG.md should be created manually following Keep-a-Changelog format

# Makefile
.PHONY: dev install version

dev:
	cargo run

install:
	cargo install --path .

version:
	cargo version

# README updates would need to be done manually
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up both a CI pipeline and a release pipeline for the `0xSero/Azul` repository. The CI pipeline checks for broken dependencies, formats the code, runs Clippy, executes tests, and builds the project for multiple platforms. The release pipeline creates a new release on GitHub, uploads the built binaries for different platforms, and marks it as a final release. Additionally, a `Makefile` is provided with commands for development, installation, and versioning. The README should be updated manually to include badges, release installation instructions, and documentation on the workflows.
